questions.prompt: Why is forecast lead time important in flood emergency management?
options: It creates time to interpret the situation, warn people and organise response actions before conditions worsen
It guarantees that the flood will follow one exact inundation boundary
It removes the need for observations and field information
It is useful only after the flood has ended
questions.answer: It creates time to interpret the situation, warn people and organise response actions before conditions worsen

questions.prompt: Which sequence describes the main layers of the artificial neural network introduced in the lecture?
options: Input layer → hidden layer → output layer
Output layer → input layer → hidden layer
Validation layer → test layer → training layer
Rainfall layer → evacuation layer → recovery layer
questions.answer: Input layer → hidden layer → output layer

questions.prompt: What does an artificial neuron do with its incoming values?
options: It combines weighted inputs and a bias, then applies an activation function to produce an output
It converts every input directly into an identical output without parameters
It stores only the largest input and ignores the others
It replaces the training data with hydraulic maps
questions.answer: It combines weighted inputs and a bias, then applies an activation function to produce an output

questions.prompt: What is the purpose of backpropagation during ANN training?
options: To use prediction error and the loss function to adjust model parameters so the error is reduced
To divide the river into one-dimensional and two-dimensional reaches
To select the final test dataset before any training takes place
To make uncertainty disappear from the forecast
questions.answer: To use prediction error and the loss function to adjust model parameters so the error is reduced

questions.prompt: Which statement correctly distinguishes training, validation and test datasets?
options: Training fits the model, validation supports model/configuration choices, and the test set is reserved for final evaluation
All three datasets are used for exactly the same purpose
The test set should be repeatedly used to adjust the model during training
Validation data replace the need for a training dataset
questions.answer: Training fits the model, validation supports model/configuration choices, and the test set is reserved for final evaluation

The model is too simple to capture meaningful patterns in the training data

questions.prompt: Which pair is identified in the lecture as learned ANN model parameters rather than hyperparameters?
options: Weights and biases
Number of neurons and activation function
Loss function and training algorithm
